title: Lack of slippage protection on trade closures
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When closing trades or reducing position sizes, the execution price can deviate significantly from expected due to two main factors:  - Spread percentage update by admin. - Price impact percentage fluctuation.  The `spreadP` and calculated `priceImpactP` used may have changed between when a trade closure is requested and when it's actually executed in the callback. However, there is currently no slippage protection mechanism to prevent trades from being closed at unexpectedly unfavorable prices due to these fluctuations.
